title: wezterm crash when cannot found default_prog without any tips on macos
body:
### What Operating System(s) are you seeing this problem on?

macOS

### Which Wayland compositor or X11 Window manager(s) are you using?

_No response_

### WezTerm version

WezTerm-macos-20230408-112425-69ae8472

### Did you try the latest nightly build to see if the issue is better (or worse!) than your current version?

Yes, and I updated the version box above to show the version of the nightly that I tried

### Describe the bug

I set 

```lua
default_prog = { "zsh" },
```

then wezterm crash immediately and without any tips.

### To Reproduce

_No response_

### Configuration


```lua
default_prog = { "zsh" },
```

### Expected Behavior

give a tips about the reason or fallback to the default shell.

### Logs

_No response_

### Anything else?

_No response_

If you prefer to use packages provided by your distribution or package manager of choice and don't want to replace that with a nightly download, keep in mind that you can download portable packages (eg: a `.dmg` file on macOS, a `.zip` file on Windows and an `.AppImage` file on Linux) that can be run without permanently installing or replacing an existing package, and can then simply be deleted once you no longer need them. 

If you are eager and can [build from source](https://wezfurlong.org/wezterm/install/source.html) then you may be able to try this out more quickly.

comments.body:
If you set `default_prog={"zsh", "-n"}` does it behave differently?
What if you use the full path to `zsh`? I'm not on my mac at the moment, but I think it is: `default_prog={"/bin/zsh"}`.
Do you have alternative zsh binary installed? Maybe there is an issue with it?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
the debugger issue is with openssl:
* https://github.com/openssl/openssl/issues/20155

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Likely blocked from updating to a version with a fix by:
* https://github.com/sfackler/rust-openssl/pull/1925

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: Ok, I'll try again when this PR is merged. It seems that the problem is related to Openssl. In addition, I remember that when these libraries of ice use webgpu, will wezterm consider replacing openssl with other implementations in the future (such as vulkan, diectx3D, etc.)?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: openssl is required by the ssh libraries used in wezterm (libssh, and libssh2), so it is unlikely to go away in the foreseeable future.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: This issue has been fixed in the latest commit(914f18b19cc5bab3dd04f699d9cea17bbcf74d5b), it's not clear why. I'll take the time to investigate.
